glosses: to include, to count, to factor in

examples.text: Meistens kann man für die Konstruktion circa eine Woche einrechnen.
examples.translation: In most cases we can allow for around a week for the design.
examples.english: In most cases we can allow for around a week for the design.

glosses: bei der Lösung einer (mathematischen) Aufgabe berücksichtigen/einbeziehen

examples.text: Wenn wir die Auswirkungen auf drei Jahre hinaus betrachten wollen, müssen wir natürlich die zu erwartende Inflation einrechnen.
Hast du eingerechnet, dass manche nicht kommen werden, weil an dem Wochenende auch die Schulabschlussfeiern sind?
Wenn du den Stoff bestellen willst, muss du die Saumzugabe einrechnen, sonst haut das vorne und hinten nicht hin.
Die Kinder mit eingerechnet werden wir 20 Personen sein.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: bei der Lösung einer (mathematischen) Aufgabe berücksichtigen/einbeziehen

examples.text: The apartment seemed like good value until we factored in the cost of the repairs.

In addition to employment in the area, once you factor in the patronage of people visiting the various sites, it's not difficult to see why it's being redeveloped. The current station building is tiny in comparison to other stations with a similar patronage.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: bei der Lösung einer (mathematischen) Aufgabe berücksichtigen/einbeziehen

glosses: To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.

examples.text: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.

glosses: To consider as part of something; to comprehend.

examples.text: The vacation package includes car rental.
Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?
I was included in the invitation to the family gathering.
up to and including page twenty-five
The whole included race, his purposed prey.
The loss of such a lord includes all harm.
I could have here willingly ranged, but these straits wherein I am included will not permit.
Come, let us go; we will include all jars / With triumphs, mirth, and rare solemnity.

glosses: To use a directive that allows the use of source code from another file.

examples.text: You have to include the strings library to use this function.

glosses: A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.

examples.text: In the previous lesson, you learned how to use server-side includes, which enable you to easily include snippets of web pages within other web pages.
